_comment: One themed challenge per calendar month (UTC). Shared by the app and the API server. Progress = missions completed this month for any of the theme's goals.

months.title: Energy Month
months.blurb: Use less energy and back cleaner ideas.

months.title: Ocean Month

months.title: Healthy Living Month
months.blurb: Look after your body and mind, and help others do the same.

months.title: Peace Month
